root_cause.summary: The lpass_tlmm pinctrl node at 0x7760000 is missing the 'clocks' and 'clock-names' properties in the Eliza EVK DTS. The driver pinctrl-lpass-lpi.c calls of_pm_clk_add_clks(dev) at probe time which reads the 'clocks' property from DTS. When the property is absent, of_clk_get() fails with -ENOENT, which propagates as probe failure.
root_cause.failure_path: of_pm_clk_add_clks -> of_clk_get_parent_count returns 0 -> returns -ENODEV -> probe returns error -> deferred probe

blocked_by_pinctrl: 7660000.codec (VA macro) — blocked on dmic67-default-state pinctrl state
blocked_by_all: sound card — VA Capture: error getting cpu dai name

fix_location: eliza.dtsi or eliza-evk.dtsi — lpass_tlmm node at 0x7760000
fix_description: Add 'clocks' and 'clock-names' properties to the lpass_tlmm pinctrl node referencing q6prmcc LPASS_HW_MACRO_VOTE and LPASS_HW_DCODEC_VOTE

eliza_specific_notes.note: eliza.dtsi does not yet have a lpass_tlmm node or q6prmcc node. Both need to be added. The q6prmcc node lives inside the q6prm service node inside the ADSP/LPASS remoteproc hierarchy. The lpass_tlmm node is a standalone platform device at 0x7760000.
eliza_specific_notes.compatible_to_use: qcom,sm8750-lpass-lpi-pinctrl or a new qcom,eliza-lpass-lpi-pinctrl (TBD based on whether Eliza reuses SM8750 pingroup layout)
eliza_specific_notes.reg_address: 0x7760000 (same as SM8750 based on log address)

unrelated_issue.note: This is a separate unrelated issue — GCC sync_state is blocked by crypto driver, not related to audio deferred probe chain.

governance.fix_scope: DTS only — no driver changes needed
governance.validation_command: Boot Eliza EVK with DTS fix and check dmesg for lpass_tlmm probe success and audio chain probe completion
